model_annotation: The provided image does not contain a “Figure 1”; instead, it displays “Figure 3,” which is a dual-axis line chart titled “新闻报道与新增病例数目统计” (Statistics of News Reports and New Case Numbers). The chart’s horizontal axis represents dates, ranging from “2020年1月1日” (January 1, 2020) to “2021年8月1日” (August 1, 2021), marked at monthly intervals. The left vertical axis, labeled “每日新增患者人数” (Daily New Patients), is scaled from 0 to 180,000 in increments of 20,000, and is represented by a blue line. The right vertical axis, labeled “新闻媒体每日报道数目” (Daily News Reports), ranges from 0 to 6,000 in increments of 1,000, and is represented by a black line. The chart visually plots the daily new patient count and the daily number of news reports over time, showing fluctuations in both metrics across the specified period. A legend at the bottom identifies the blue line as “每日全球确诊数” (Daily Global Confirmed Cases) and the black line as “有关covid-19新闻数量” (Number of COVID-19-related News Reports). The chart is accompanied by a caption and explanatory text that discusses the correlation between the number of news reports and the number of new cases, noting a three-stage trend from outbreak to peak to decline.
